steps.title: Aliquot serum or plasma
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen serum or plasma if needed and aliquot exactly 100 µl of each sample into a clean tube.

steps.title: Add QIAzol and mix
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl of QIAzol Lysis Reagent to each 100 µl aliquot, then vortex or pipette up‑and‑down to mix thoroughly. After addition, lysates may be stored at –70 °C for several months.

steps.title: Incubate homogenate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Place the tube on the benchtop at room temperature (15–25 °C) for 5 minutes to promote dissociation of nucleoprotein complexes.

steps.title: Add spike‑in control (optional)
steps.instruction: Optionally add 3.5 µl of the working solution of Syn‑cel‑miR‑39 miScript miRNA Mimic to each tube.

steps.title: Add chloroform and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume of chloroform to the tube, close it securely, and vortex vigorously for 15 seconds. Thorough mixing is essential for subsequent phase separation.

steps.title: Incubate after chloroform addition
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at room temperature (15–25 °C) for 2–3 minutes.

steps.title: Phase separation centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 15 minutes at 12 000 × g and 4 °C. After the run, allow the centrifuge to warm to room temperature (15–25 °C) if it will be used for subsequent spins. The sample will separate into an upper aqueous phase (RNA), a white interphase, and a lower red organic phase.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase and add ethanol
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new collection tube supplied in the kit, avoiding any interphase material. Record the volume transferred, multiply it by 1.5, and add that volume of 100 % ethanol. Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down several times. Do not centrifuge; a precipitate may form but does not affect the procedure.

steps.title: Load sample onto spin column (first load)
steps.instruction: Pipet up to 700 µl of the ethanol‑mixed sample (including any precipitate) onto an RNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube (both supplied in the kit).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g (≥10 000 rpm) for 15 seconds at room temperature (15–25 °C).
Discard the flow‑through (contains QIAzol and is not bleach‑compatible).
Reuse the collection tube for the next step.

steps.title: Load remaining sample onto spin column
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous loading step with the remaining volume of the ethanol‑mixed sample.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g (≥10 000 rpm) for 15 seconds at room temperature.
Discard the flow‑through (contains QIAzol and is not bleach‑compatible).
Reuse the collection tube for the next step.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer RWT
steps.instruction: Add 700 µl of Buffer RWT to the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g (≥10 000 rpm) for 15 seconds.
Discard the flow‑through (contains Buffer RWT and is not bleach‑compatible).
Reuse the collection tube for the next step.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer RPE (first)
steps.instruction: Pipet 500 µl of Buffer RPE onto the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g (≥10 000 rpm) for 15 seconds.
Discard the flow‑through and reuse the collection tube for the next step.

steps.title: Repeat Buffer RPE wash
steps.instruction: Add a second 500 µl of Buffer RPE to the spin column and centrifuge as before.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at ≥8 000 × g (≥10 000 rpm) for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Dry spin column membrane
steps.instruction: Place the spin column into a new 2 ml collection tube (not supplied), discard the old tube with flow‑through, and centrifuge in a microcentrifuge at full speed for 2 minutes to dry the membrane and remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute RNA from spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new 1.5 ml collection tube (supplied in the kit). Pipet 30–50 µl of RNase‑free water directly onto the membrane, close the lid, and centrifuge for 1 minute at ≥8 000 × g (≥10 000 rpm) to elute RNA. For higher miRNA recovery, repeat the elution with a second 30–50 µl water addition and centrifuge again for 1 minute at the same speed.
